title: data set: statusline data — read-failure kinds, degraded kinds, wiring outcomes, display budgets, copy
description: Round 3 of #598: contract items 3 + 15 plus the four routed findings of 'phase-1c work item: statusline wiring script shape' (#362). Contents: the state read-failure kinds (absent, malformed, permission-or-io) with machine tokens, kind-to-action mapping into the action vocabulary's recovery family (1:1, established at round 2), and per-kind human diagnostic + recovery text; the degraded kinds (tracker-absent benign-offline, tracker-unusable) with marker words and next-step text; the six-member wiring-outcome enumeration from the Install requirement; per-field width budgets and worded absences for the segment's display fields; the worded truncation mark and broken-state mark; the whole-invocation wall-clock budget with a flake-resistant timing-check shape; the repo-set configuration (location, format, ownership vs drift-refusal, explicit N with aggregate cost = N x per-repo budget); the composition-instruction conduct covering wrapper and opaque-command statusLines. Every number and every copy string is an operator-owned proposal until adoption (The operator authors the oracle). Owner: data-engineer. Validator: ux (the copy and glanceability are that lens's exact concern; a11y coordination flagged for the worded-marks discipline).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: OPERATOR ADOPTION 2026-07-20, all three blocks as proposed: numbers (width budgets 16/20/10/24/24; wall-clock 250ms per repo, whole invocation; timing check 7 runs, median at-or-under budget, max at-or-under twice budget), copy (marker words offline/degraded with the benign-offline distinction carried in the next-step texts; worded truncation and broken-state marks; absence texts; per-kind diagnostic and recovery strings), and the #362 shapes (adopter-owned repo-set config at ~/.config/vsdd/statusline.yaml with explicit count and aggregate cost = count x per-repo budget; two-shape composition instruction). Data Engineer pass under the session's loaded lens: no new findings — pair rule followed, kind coverage pinned by schema min/max items, kind-to-action referential constraint declared against the round-2 recovery family, numbers are data not code constants; coverage otherwise as round 2's declaration. UX validator note for the set's spec-review round: glanceability of the five-field segment at the adopted widths (94 chars worst case plus separators) is the open judgment item — flagged, not blocking adoption of the data.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Resolved: the set landed as the pair with all adoptions applied. Evidence: the round-3 commit, mdatron verify clean after catching three more flow-map-comma defects at the first attempt — the pair rule's second and third live catches.
